title: Check SEO Data using "View Page Source"
text:
## Check SEO Data using "View Page Source"
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000053666

## Overview
When SEO or social sharing updates are made, the website's source code can be reviewed to confirm the changes were applied.

## Steps
Open the page to be checked.
Right-click anywhere on the page and select View Page Source .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184799873/original/PVhPIvLlX142XXc9KQ2hAtKf8ie1OHBz2Q.png?1788783778 | alt: ]
Alternatively, the source code can be accessed using a keyboard shortcut: Ctrl + U on most browsers, or Option + Command + U in Safari. All major browsers support this functionality.
Within the source code view, use the standard browser search command, Ctrl + F , to scan for specific SEO elements.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184799879/original/B2phrm-Q483zjsry8700kFQdnchCDH6DRg.jpeg?1788783791 | alt: ]
